##### Project general facts

Crystal Tower by VHS is a contemporary residential building designed with a focus on modern comfort and everyday convenience. Its exterior combines contemporary architecture with elegant, clean lines, while modern materials highlight minimalism and purity of form and help the facade blend gracefully into its urban surroundings. The building rises above a ground floor and two podium levels to seven residential floors and a roof, offering studios, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, together with retail units.

Amenities are designed for wellness, family time and social life. Residents can enjoy an adult swimming pool with a poolside lounge and a children's pool, a fully equipped gym, a yoga area and a jogging track. A kids' play area, a game lounge with billiards, foosball, air hockey and table tennis, a barbecue area, a co-working space and multipurpose community halls add variety, while landscaped gardens, a pet-friendly policy and parking with electric vehicle chargers complete the offer.

Every home is planned with smart layouts that make the most of space and fill the apartments with natural light. Living and dining areas open onto balconies, and bedrooms offer quiet, comfortable retreats with built-in storage. A smart home system adds comfort and control, and round-the-clock security provides peace of mind. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, and retail units at ground level bring everyday shopping and services within easy reach of residents.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai International City is a large residential and commercial community in the east of Dubai, known for its themed country clusters, wide choice of apartments and lively retail scene. Dragon Mart, one of the largest trading hubs for Chinese goods outside China, sits at its edge, while supermarkets, restaurants, clinics and everyday services are spread throughout the neighbourhood for residents.

Dragon Mart and the nearest metro station are a short drive away, and Dubai International Airport and Dubai Safari Park are also close by. Al Awir Road, Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai, Palm Jumeirah and Al Maktoum International Airport, keeping the wider city within comfortable reach for daily commuting and weekend leisure.

Dubai International City is a freehold area that attracts first-time buyers, young professionals and investors seeking accessible entry points. Strong rental demand driven by proximity to the airport, major highways and trading hubs supports some of the most attractive rental yields in the city. Continued improvements to infrastructure and the arrival of modern residential buildings strengthen the long-term appeal of the area.
